item/consumable/mysticism/buff/mana_attu.name: BUFF: Candorian Manahunter
item/consumable/mysticism/buff/mana_attu.desc:
When active, increases WILD TROVIAN MANA obtained from Harvesting while in CANDORIAN Adventure World Biomes until the current DAY ends. Additionally, defeating enemies while in Candoria will yield Wild Trovian Mana.

<font color='#ffcf72'>You may only have ONE (1) BUFF active at a time.</font>

item/consumable/titles/biome_isletreasur.name: Title: Matey
item/consumable/titles/biome_isletreasur.desc: Craft to gain access to the 'Matey' title prefix.

item/crafting/acrobatbark.name: Acrobat Bark
item/crafting/acrobatbark.desc:
Geode Cave Crafting Material.

Hangs down from the ceilings in Tiers 2-4 of Moonglow Grotto.

item/crafting/chaoscore.name: Chaos Core
item/crafting/chaoscore.desc:
Used to craft rare chaotic collectibles at the Chaos Core Crafter.

Acquire from Chaos Chests and by Loot Collecting Chaos Chests rewards.

item/crafting/crystal.name: Crystal
item/crafting/crystal.desc:
Geode Cave Crafting Material.

A plentiful crafting material found on Geode in caves and inside cave walls.

item/crafting/cupcake.name: Wild Cupcake
item/crafting/cupcake.desc:
Crafting Material.

Found growing from the ground in Candoria, or grown through Gardening.

item/crafting/darksoul.name: Somber Soul
item/crafting/darksoul.desc:
Crafting Material.

Found in ore veins in the Cursed Vale biome.

item/crafting/delvebanner/banner_flag_un.name: Darkshroom Standard
item/crafting/delvebanner/banner_flag_un.desc: Found somewhere within Delves. Used to craft Light Banners at the Delve Workbench.

item/crafting/delvebanner/banner_pole_as.name: Banner Pole of the Martial Way
item/crafting/delvebanner/banner_pole_as.desc: Found somewhere within Depth 25+ Delves, this Banner Pole creates Banners that increase Physical Damage

item/crafting/dragoncoin.name: Dragon Coin
item/crafting/dragoncoin.desc:
Used to hatch Dragons at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub.

Acquire by doing challenges or from the Dragon tab in the store (Press [HK:Store] Key).

item/crafting/enchwood.name: Enchanted Wood
item/crafting/enchwood.desc:
Crafting Material.

Usually found growing in the Fae Forest, Medieval Highlands, or Cursed Vale biomes, but also obtainable through Gardening.

item/crafting/events/september2021_fae_t.name: Token of Fae Honor
item/crafting/events/september2021_fae_t.desc:
Proof of Fae Honor! Gained from hunting Undead in the Fae Forest.

<font color='#ff3030'>Disappears</font> at the end of the Fae Vs Undead event.

item/crafting/eye.name: Eye of Q'bthulhu
item/crafting/eye.desc:
Forging Material.

Found rarely as a drop from invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

item/crafting/faeriedust.name: Faerie Dust
item/crafting/faeriedust.desc:
Crafting Material.

Drops from Fae enemies, most commonly found in the Fae Wilds.

item/crafting/fertilizer_water.name: Rich Fertilizer
item/crafting/fertilizer_water.desc:
Crafting Material.

Harvested from Unripe Fertilizer Heaps, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

item/crafting/flux.name: Flux
item/crafting/flux.desc:
Crafting Material.

Gain Flux from using the Loot Collector on equipment.

item/crafting/geode_module_barrier.name: Shield Sparker
item/crafting/geode_module_barrier.desc:
Used to craft the Barrier Generator, a module helpful to cave exploration.

Obtained from Amberine's Geode Caves Expertise Quest.

item/crafting/meteor_fragment.name: Meteorite Fragment
item/crafting/meteor_fragment.desc:
Crafting Material.

Found only in the Primal Preserve tree canopy of the Jurassic Jungle.

item/crafting/moonlitmoss.name: Moonlit Moss
item/crafting/moonlitmoss.desc:
Geode Cave Crafting Material.

Clinging plants found throughout Tiers 2-4 of the Geode caves.

item/crafting/moonstone.name: Moonstone
item/crafting/moonstone.desc:
Geode Cave Crafting Material.

Delicate, shimmery ore harvested only in Tiers 1-3 of Moonglow Grotto.

item/crafting/mushroomparts.name: Mushroom Chunk
item/crafting/mushroomparts.desc:
Crafting Material.

Gained through Gardening and from mushrooms found in the world.

item/crafting/ore_cinnabar.name: Cinnabar
item/crafting/ore_cinnabar.desc:
Crafting material.

A mysterious reddish ore native to the Forbidden Spires.

item/crafting/ore_rare.name: Infinium Ore
item/crafting/ore_rare.desc:
Crafting Material.

A rare, golden ore found in most biomes.

item/crafting/ore_sky.name: Crystallized Cloud
item/crafting/ore_sky.desc:
Crafting Material.

A unique ore found only in the Sky Realms.

item/crafting/ore_uncommon.name: Formicite Ore
item/crafting/ore_uncommon.desc:
Crafting Material.

An uncommon, turquoise ore found in most biomes.

item/crafting/radiantshard.name: Radiant Shard
item/crafting/radiantshard.desc:
Crafting Material.

Earned by completing the Dark Heart dungeons found in the Sky Realms.

item/crafting/robotparts.name: Robotic Salvage
item/crafting/robotparts.desc:
Crafting Material.

Found by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.

item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_block.name: Rune Slate
item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_block.desc:
Layering magic and matter, Rune Slate provides a metaphorical lattice upon which all Runic magic can grow and thrive.
Used by the Runecrafting profession.

item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_fragment.name: Rune Fragment
item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_fragment.desc: Used by Runecrafters to craft basic Runes, as well as materials for more advanced Runes.

item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_paper.name: Rune Paper
item/crafting/runecrafting/rune_paper.desc:
Imbuing Blank Scrolls with primal energies, Runecrafters can craft this thin, flexible material. It is resistant arcane stress and smells like chemicals... in a good way.
Used by the Runecrafting profession.

item/crafting/runecrafting/stone/rune_gl.name: Shining Rune
item/crafting/runecrafting/stone/rune_gl.desc: Breaks when your magic find triggers, granting a Gearcrafter's Vault.

item/crafting/seashell.name: Golden Seashell
item/crafting/seashell.desc:
Crafting Material.

Found most often in the Treasure Isles.

item/crafting/shadowshard.name: Shadow Shard
item/crafting/shadowshard.desc:
Crafting Material. Used to craft mounts and items on the Shadowy Market such as Shadow Caches.

A plentiful crafting material found in Delves.

item/crafting/title/title_authorization.name: Title Authorization Form
item/crafting/title/title_authorization.desc: Each one signed ahead-of-time by a single Trovian officiant! Some are famous!

item/crafting/title/title_stamp.name: Official Trovian Document Stamper
item/crafting/title/title_stamp.desc:
Used to officially notarize important Trovian documents for official Trovian officials!

A micro-laboratory embedded in the handle can turn almost ANYTHING into ink suitable for Title signing!

NOTE!: The Official Trovian Document Stamper automatically returns to inventory after crafting titles. One is all you need!

item/crafting/warpseed.name: Glim
item/crafting/warpseed.desc:
Trading Material. Exchange for items from the pirates of Treasure Isles.

Obtained by Loot Collecting fish and breaking plants in the world.

item/currency/coin_pvp_current.name: Battle Coin
item/currency/coin_pvp_current.desc: Obtained by participating in Battle Mode (Player-versus-Player) Matches.

item/currency/delve_basic.name: Inert Geode
item/currency/delve_basic.desc: Hoarded by Bosses within Delves, these interesting mineral formations are of great interest to the Sunseekers

item/currency/mysticism/wild_trovian_man.name: Wild Trovian Mana
item/currency/mysticism/wild_trovian_man.desc:
Migrates its way across all Trovian ADVENTURE WORLD biomes.

Whispers in the HUB suggest those familiar with MYSTICISM use Mana.

item/dragon/egg/green_notrade_fragment_n.name: Preserver Dragon Egg Fragment
item/dragon/egg/green_notrade_fragment_n.desc:
Coax a new flying dragon from the egg fragments using the Dragon Crucible in the Hub!

These fragments can be obtained rarely from dinosaurs.

item/fish/chocolate/common_01.name: Mint Choctacoise
item/fish/chocolate/common_01.desc: Common fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/chocolate/rare_chocodile.name: Chocodile
item/fish/chocolate/rare_chocodile.desc: Rare Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/chocolate/uncommon_ore_cinnaba.name: Cinnabar Orefish
item/fish/chocolate/uncommon_ore_cinnaba.desc: Uncommon Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/enchanted/rare_merqubesly.name: Deep Sea Merthing
item/fish/enchanted/rare_merqubesly.desc: Rare Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/lava/common_05.name: Dancing Dragonfish
item/fish/lava/common_05.desc: Common Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/lava/rare_treasureisle.name: Tropical Volcanofish
item/fish/lava/rare_treasureisle.desc: Rare Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/lava/uncommon_swordfish.name: Lava Lancefish
item/fish/lava/uncommon_swordfish.desc: Uncommon Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/plasma/plasma_rare_02.name: Zapparapa Eel
item/fish/plasma/plasma_rare_02.desc: Rare fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/plasma/uncommon_elemental.name: Plasma Belemental
item/fish/plasma/uncommon_elemental.desc: Uncommon Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/water/common_maxuber_abyssalan.name: Abyssal Angler
item/fish/water/common_maxuber_abyssalan.desc: Common Long Shade Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/water/rare_maxuber_pyricjellyf.name: Pyric Jellyfish
item/fish/water/rare_maxuber_pyricjellyf.desc: Rare Long Shade Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/fish/water/uncommon_maxuber_abyssal.name: Abyssal Seahorse
item/fish/water/uncommon_maxuber_abyssal.desc: Uncommon Long Shade Fish. Loot Collect it to gain resources and add it to your collection.

item/lootbox/holiday/september2021_deco_.name: Tombs Decoration Treasure Box
item/lootbox/holiday/september2021_deco_.desc: Contains decoration objects from the Fae vs. Undead event.

item/luxion_lands/access_token_autoconsu.name: Luxion's Pact (Difficulty 10)
item/luxion_lands/access_token_autoconsu.desc:
Grants access to the Trials of Luxion (Moonless Dark Difficulty) until the END of the CURRENT DAY.

Within the Trials, some stats are capped and some of your collected & crafted Venturine (and related items) are deducted from your inventory upon dying.

item/luxion_lands/currency_signet.name: Venturine Signet
item/luxion_lands/currency_signet.desc:
Used to craft rewards from Luxion's Hoard.

"Legends say crafting this item takes a small fragment of one's soul... but that doesn't seem possible, does it?!"

item/luxion_lands/limited_resource_soul.name: Unfortunate Soul
item/luxion_lands/limited_resource_soul.desc: The once-living essence of a fallen adventurer, crystallized into a pocket-sized trinket!

item/mount/archeoceratops_armored.name: Mount: Armored Archaeoceratops
item/mount/archeoceratops_armored.desc: Anachronistic, but geared up and ready for adventure.

item/mount/carpet_cauldron.name: Mount: Hovering Cauldron
item/mount/carpet_cauldron.desc: When flying on a broom just won't cut it.

item/mount/dog_corgi_fire.name: Mount: Pember
item/mount/dog_corgi_fire.desc:
So cute you burst into flame.

This is a tradable mount.

item/mount/dragon_bomberroyale_sticky.name: Golden Furious Dragon Egg
item/mount/dragon_bomberroyale_sticky.desc:
Hatches into Zyntryn, the Fury!

Having this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +10% Critical Damage, +5 Jump, and +50 Magic Find.

item/mount/dragon_green.name: Golden Preserver Dragon Egg
item/mount/dragon_green.desc: Hatches into Miraldis, the Primordial Preserver!

item/mount/dragonbug_kami.name: Kami of Vivid Volitation
item/mount/dragonbug_kami.desc: Soar above life's troubles with the help of a friend.

item/mount/mammoth_sunlightbulb.name: Mount: Smooth Sunlightosaur
item/mount/mammoth_sunlightbulb.desc: Spreads love, sunshine and bulbs everywhere he goes.

item/mount/raptor_turkeyroast.name: Mount: Roast Rider
item/mount/raptor_turkeyroast.desc: It doesn't appreciate being snacked on, no exceptions.

item/mount/triceratops_shark_abyss.name: Sergeant of the Abyss
item/mount/triceratops_shark_abyss.desc: Patiently patrols just under the surface, waiting for someone to take the bait.

item/pet/ball_bee.name: Ally: Bouncee the Bee
item/pet/ball_bee.desc: It flies, it just prefers to bounce.

item/pet/butterfly_solsat.name: Ally: Solar-Powered Satellizer
item/pet/butterfly_solsat.desc: This bitty bug bot is an advanced experiment in energy self-sufficient automata.

item/pet/griffon_sunderer.name: Ally: Sundered Shard
item/pet/griffon_sunderer.desc: A fragment of the Sunderer who won't stop following you around.

item/pet/howlug_witch.name: Bewitching Howlug
item/pet/howlug_witch.desc: He hopes you like his costume. Gabbro worked very hard on it.

item/pet/howlug_witch_trade.name: Bewitching Howlug
item/pet/howlug_witch_trade.desc: He hopes you like his costume. Gabbro worked very hard on it.

item/pet/llama_pinata.name: Ally: Pinata Parvati
item/pet/llama_pinata.desc: This little llama is all snuggles and hugs.

item/pet/raptor_fluxbeast.name: Lil Fluxbeast
item/pet/raptor_fluxbeast.desc: Careful when petting this lovely, little, gleaming bundle of joy. Its flux spikes are pointy!

item/pet/snake_lucky.name: Ally: Lucksnake
item/pet/snake_lucky.desc: Sir O'Lucky likes to teach them magic before releasing them into the wild.

item/pet/unicorn_kamirainbow.name: Ally: Kami of Guileless Wonder
item/pet/unicorn_kamirainbow.desc: Shed your preconceptions, and marvel at all the miracles that surround you.

item/terraforming/september2021_fae_tomb.name: Undead Tombs Terraformer
item/terraforming/september2021_fae_tomb.desc:
Terraform a zone into Undead Tombs found in the Fae Wilds.

<font color='#ff3030'>Warning:</font> This will destroy everything in that zone, as well as the borders of adjacent zones.

item/unlocker/ally_dev.name: The Dev Dream
item/unlocker/ally_dev.desc: Grants a random, Dev-inspired ally you don't already have unlocked.

item/unlocker/events/nov2021_bunfest_egg.name: Special Order: Bunfest Nobles Recipes
item/unlocker/events/nov2021_bunfest_egg.desc: Teaches the recipe teaching the ability to craft the Bunfest Bounty decoration and food at the Friendsgiving Oven.

item/unlocker/martialarts/weapon_style_1.name: Style: Striking Sai
item/unlocker/martialarts/weapon_style_1.desc: Unlocks the Striking Sai sword style, or gives Positive Karma if that style is already unlocked.

item/unlocker/recipe_geodehub_framework.name: Geodian Framework Vault
item/unlocker/recipe_geodehub_framework.desc: Unlock a random Geodian Framework recipe from the Geodian Workbench that you have not yet collected.
